mapper.select: SELECT S.SURVEY_NO, S.EMP_CODE, S.SURVEY_MAIN_TITLE, S.SURVEY_ENTIRE_TARGET_FL, S.SURVEY_START_DATE AS SURVEY_START_DATE_DATE, S.SURVEY_END_DATE + 1 AS SURVEY_END_DATE_DATE, E.EMP_LAST_NAME || E.EMP_FIRST_NAME AS FULL_NAME FROM SURVEY S LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE E ON S.EMP_CODE = E.EMP_CODE WHERE S.SURVEY_ENTIRE_TARGET_FL = 'Y' AND S.SURVEY_END_DATE + 1 >= SYSDATE AND S.COM_NO = #{comNo}

SELECT S.SURVEY_NO, S.EMP_CODE, S.SURVEY_MAIN_TITLE, S.SURVEY_ENTIRE_TARGET_FL, S.SURVEY_START_DATE SURVEY_START_DATE_DATE, S.SURVEY_END_DATE + 1 SURVEY_END_DATE_DATE FROM SURVEY_TARGET ST LEFT JOIN SURVEY S ON (ST.SURVEY_NO = S.SURVEY_NO) WHERE ST.EMP_CODE = #{empCode} AND S.SURVEY_END_DATE + 1 >= SYSDATE ORDER BY S.SURVEY_END_DATE DESC
SELECT SURVEY_SUB_NO FROM SURVEY_SUB WHERE SURVEY_NO = #{surveyNo}
SELECT COM_NO FROM EMPLOYEE WHERE EMP_CODE = #{empCode}

SELECT SURVEY_NO, EMP_CODE, SURVEY_MAIN_TITLE, SURVEY_ENTIRE_TARGET_FL, TO_CHAR(SURVEY_START_DATE, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일"') AS SURVEY_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(SURVEY_END_DATE, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일"') AS SURVEY_END_DATE, TOTAL_RESPONSE_COUNT FROM SURVEY WHERE SURVEY_NO = #{surveyNo}
SELECT * FROM SURVEY_SUB WHERE SURVEY_NO = #{surveyNo}
SELECT * FROM SURVEY_MULTIPLE WHERE SURVEY_SUB_NO = #{surveySubNo}
SELECT * FROM SURVEY_SUB WHERE SURVEY_SUB_NO = #{hintSurveySubNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE SURVEY SET TOTAL_RESPONSE_COUNT = TOTAL_RESPONSE_COUNT + 1 WHERE SURVEY_NO = #{surveyNo}
mapper.select: SELECT S.SURVEY_NO, S.EMP_CODE, S.SURVEY_MAIN_TITLE, S.SURVEY_ENTIRE_TARGET_FL, S.SURVEY_START_DATE AS SURVEY_START_DATE_DATE, S.SURVEY_END_DATE + 1 AS SURVEY_END_DATE_DATE , E.EMP_LAST_NAME || E.EMP_FIRST_NAME AS FULL_NAME FROM SURVEY S LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE E ON E.EMP_CODE = S.EMP_CODE WHERE S.EMP_CODE = #{empCode} ORDER BY S.SURVEY_END_DATE DESC OFFSET #{startRow} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEE WHERE COM_NO = #{comNo}
SELECT TOTAL_RESPONSE_COUNT FROM SURVEY WHERE SURVEY_NO = #{surveyNo}
SELECT POSITION_NM FROM POSITION WHERE COM_NO = #{comNo}
SELECT E.*, T.TEAM_NM FROM EMPLOYEE E LEFT JOIN TEAM T ON (T.TEAM_NO = E.TEAM_NO) WHERE E.COM_NO = #{comNo} AND CONCAT(E.EMP_LAST_NAME, E.EMP_FIRST_NAME) LIKE '%' || #{empNickname} || '%'
SELECT SEQ_SURVEY.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SURVEY VALUES ( #{surveyNo}, #{empCode}, #{title}, TO_DATE(#{surveyStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , TO_DATE(#{surveyEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{surveyEntireTargetFl}, 0, #{comNo} )
mapper.select: SELECT SEQ_SURVEY_SUB.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SURVEY_ANSWER WHERE SURVEY_SUB_NO = #{surveySubNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SURVEY_ANSWER WHERE ANSWER = #{surveyMultipleNo}
SELECT SA.*, E.EMP_LAST_NAME || E.EMP_FIRST_NAME AS FULL_NAME, E.PROFILE_IMG FROM SURVEY_ANSWER SA LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE E ON (E.EMP_CODE = SA.EMP_CODE) WHERE SURVEY_SUB_NO = #{surveySubNo}
SELECT * FROM SURVEY WHERE SURVEY_NO = #{surveyNo}
SELECT SURVEY_SUB_NO FROM SURVEY_SUB WHERE SURVEY_NO = #{surveyNo}
